slides.title: Automate the step, not the judgment.
slides.sub: Three questions I ask before AI goes into a product workflow.

paras: A premium sportscar brand's online shop needed every product image to work on web and mobile.
We changed the input: one shoot per product in a flexible frame. AI crops the images and delivers them to the shop backend.
slides.title: Which step repeats for every product?
Three questions first
items: Which step repeats for every single item?
Can a person check the result at a glance?
Who decides when the output is wrong?
slides.punch: Automate the first. Keep the last human.

slides.title: Fix the output or the input?
slides.before: Every new format means more manual work at the end.
slides.after: Design the input once, so every format gets what it needs.
slides.punch: Change the input, not the output.

slides.caption: Image workflow cost, at least
slides.lesson: Automate the repeated step. Keep the judgment with people.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
